cases.source: The planned tasks are: "Check manifest", "Load trailer", "Seal trailer" and "Dispatch truck". The manifest check must conclude before loading starts: "Check manifest" before "Load trailer". "Seal trailer" follows "Load trailer". We may dispatch the truck only after "Seal trailer". Give a valid order.

Our show checklist contains "Rig lights", "Test lights" and "Open doors". The lighting test cannot happen until the rig is installed. Specifically, "Test lights" waits for "Rig lights". The audience enters after "Test lights": "Open doors" comes later. Find an execution order.

Four steps belong to this lab run: "Sterilize bench", "Prepare medium", "Seed cells" and "Log sample". Before "Seed cells" can start, both "Sterilize bench" and "Prepare medium" must be complete. Record the sample once "Seed cells" finishes: "Log sample" is downstream of seeding. Return a valid schedule.
edges: "Sterilize bench" and "Prepare medium" must be complete
"Sterilize bench" and "Prepare medium" must be complete
